fullDescription: A graphite near-monochrome premium SaaS marketing homepage with a single platinum accent: charcoal #1c1c1e to #2c2c2e surfaces, off-white Inter text, a sticky glass nav, a restrained left-aligned hero with a platinum gradient-clipped headline and a large in-page product-canvas mock, a quiet logo row, a thin numbered feature list, a testimonial + stats split, minimal 3-tier pricing, and a 4-column footer. Linear-like restraint, in graphite.
prompt:
## Resumo
A graphite, near-monochrome premium SaaS marketing homepage with a single platinum accent. A sticky, glassy charcoal nav sits above a restrained left-aligned hero (a pill 'version' badge, a huge platinum gradient-clipped display headline, a light subhead, and a small inline 'New' link), followed by a large in-page product-canvas mock (an app toolbar, a layers rail, a generated revenue-dashboard card with KPI cells and a bar chart, and a right prompt panel) framed in a soft-shadow card on a dotted grid. Below: a quiet centered logo row, a thin numbered feature list (4 rows, no cards), a two-up testimonial + stats/terminal panel, a minimal 3-tier pricing block (the middle plan featured), a centered closing CTA over a grain wash, and a 4-column dark footer. The signature is the restraint: graphite surfaces #1c1c1e to #2c2c2e, one platinum/silver accent #c7c7cc (with a #ffffff to #c7c7cc gradient clipped onto display text and used on the primary pill button), off-white #f2f2f4 text, tight Inter throughout, hairline #39393c borders, soft platinum-ring shadows, and faint radial grain + dot-grid textures. Linear-like calm, but graphite rather than violet.

## Estilo Visual
Graphite near-monochrome premium SaaS landing page with a single platinum accent. Exact palette via tailwind.config custom colors: ink #1c1c1e (page bg), ink2 #202022, ink3 #252527, panel #2c2c2e (graphite surfaces), line #39393c and line2 #2e2e30 (hairline borders), plat #c7c7cc and plat2 #aeaeb2 (platinum accent + secondary text), off #f2f2f4 (primary text), mute #8e8e93 and mute2 #6c6c70 (eyebrow/micro-label greys). Body is bg-ink text-off font-sans antialiased with tracking-tight; a custom letterSpacing tightest -0.045em is used on display headings. The ONLY accent is platinum: never introduce indigo/violet/blue. Primary pill button = .btn-plat (background: linear-gradient(180deg,#ededf0,#c7c7cc)) with dark ink text, hover:brightness-105. Display headings use .plat-text: background: linear-gradient(180deg,#ffffff 0%,#c7c7cc 100%); -webkit-background-clip:text; background-clip:text; color:transparent. Glassy nav = .glass: background rgba(28,28,30,0.72); backdrop-filter saturate(140%) blur(14px). Soft depth = .ring-soft: box-shadow 0 0 0 1px rgba(199,199,204,0.10), 0 40px 80px -40px rgba(0,0,0,0.85). Featured surfaces = .card-sheen: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(199,199,204,0.05), rgba(199,199,204,0) 40%), #242426. Atmospheric wash = .grain: radial-gradient(900px 500px at 50% -8%, rgba(199,199,204,0.07), transparent 60%) plus a second smaller radial. Canvas texture = .dot-grid: radial-gradient(rgba(199,199,204,0.10) 1px, transparent 1px) at 22px 22px. Divider = .hairline: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(199,199,204,0.18) 22%/78%, transparent). ::selection is bg #c7c7cc on #1c1c1e. Icons are Iconify Phosphor (ph:) glyphs in platinum or off-white. html { scroll-behavior: smooth }.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Sticky glass nav
A fixed top-0 inset-x-0 z-50 header with .glass (rgba(28,28,30,0.72) + backdrop-blur 14px) and a 1px bottom border in line2 (#2e2e30). Inside: mx-auto max-w-[1200px] px-6 -> lg:px-8, h-16 flex row space-between. Left = brand lockup: a 7x7 rounded-lg square filled with a from-plat to-plat2 (top-to-bottom platinum) gradient holding a dark ink ph:sparkle-fill (15px), beside the wordmark 'Slate' (text-[15px] font-semibold off). Center (hidden md:flex, gap-8, text-[13.5px] plat2): Product / Features / Customers / Pricing / Docs, each hover:text-off. Right (gap-3, text-[13.5px]): a 'Log in' text link (hidden sm:inline, plat2) plus a .btn-plat 'Get started' pill (platinum gradient, dark ink text, px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-full, hover:brightness-105).

### Hero
A relative .grain section, pt-16. Centered content mx-auto max-w-[1200px] px-6 -> lg:px-8, pt-28 -> lg:pt-40, pb-12. Top: an inline-flex rounded-full pill badge (border line, bg-ink3, px-3 py-1, text-[12px] plat2) with a 1.5x1.5 plat dot + 'Slate 3.0 - agent-native canvas'. Then a max-w-[15ch] display H1 in .plat-text: 'The design system for shipping real interfaces' at text-[clamp(2.6rem,7vw,5.6rem)] leading-[0.97] tracking-tightest font-semibold. Below (mt-9, flex-col -> sm:flex-row, items-end, space-between, gap-6): a max-w-[46ch] lead paragraph 'Describe what you want in plain language. Slate generates production-grade UI, components, and full flows on an infinite canvas.' (font-light plat2), and a small right-aligned inline link group 'New  Coding-agent skill ->' (text-[13.5px] plat2, the word 'New' in off font-medium, ph:arrow-right that nudges on hover).

### Hero product-canvas mock
Below the hero copy, mx-auto max-w-[1200px] px-6 -> lg:px-8 pb-24, a rounded-2xl border-line bg-ink2 .ring-soft overflow-hidden panel that fakes the app canvas (NOT a browser/device frame). Top app toolbar (h-11, border-b line2, bg-ink3, px-4, space-between): left = a plat ph:sparkle-fill (13px) + 'Untitled canvas' (off font-medium) + '/ Dashboard redesign' (mute2), all text-[12.5px]; right (hidden sm:flex, mute2) = ph:cursor, ph:selection, ph:magnifying-glass icons + a '100%' zoom pill (bg-panel, rounded-md). Body = a 12-col grid, min-h-[340px], .dot-grid. Left rail (hidden lg:flex col-span-2, border-r line2, bg-ink2/80, p-3): a 'LAYERS' eyebrow then layer rows (Screen highlighted on bg-panel, Header, Stat cards, Chart, indented Legend, Table) each a ph: icon + label at text-[12.5px]. Center generated UI (col-span-12 -> lg:col-span-7, p-5/6): a .card-sheen rounded-xl border-line p-5 card titled 'Revenue overview' / 'Last 30 days' with a Day/Week segmented toggle (Week active on bg-plat dark-ink), a 3-up KPI row (MRR $9.2k / Active 5,140 / Churn 2.1% in rounded-lg border-line2 bg-ink2 cells), and a 9-bar bar chart (h-24, flex items-end gap-2) where most bars are bg-line and two accent bars are bg-plat/bg-plat2; an absolute top-right 'Generated' pill (bg-plat dark-ink, hidden lg:block). Right prompt panel (hidden lg:flex col-span-3, border-l line2, bg-ink2/80, p-4): a 'PROMPT' eyebrow, a quoted example prompt in a rounded-lg border-line bg-ink3 box, a 'Generating variants...' line with a spinning ph:circle-notch (plat), two skeleton bars, and a bottom 'Ask Slate to refine...' input row with a ph:sparkle.

### Logo row
A quiet trust strip: a section with border-y line2 and bg-ink2/40. Inside mx-auto max-w-[1200px] px-6 -> lg:px-8 py-10: a centered uppercase eyebrow 'Trusted by teams building at speed' (text-[12px] tracking-[0.18em] mute2), then a flex-wrap justify-center row (gap-x-12 gap-y-6, opacity-70) of six faux company lockups, each a ph: geometric glyph (hexagon/triangle/circle-half/square/diamond/asterisk) + an extrabold-ish plat2 wordmark: Northwind, Vantage, Corewave, Monoco, Lattice, Forma.

### Feature list (thin, numbered)
Section id=features, py-28. A max-w-[40ch] header: eyebrow 'Built for the work', then an H2 .plat-text 'Everything between idea and shippable UI'. Below, a divide-y divide-line2 list bounded by border-y line2 (NO cards). Each row is a grid md:grid-cols-12 gap-5 py-8: col-span-1 = a tabular-nums mute2 index (01-04); col-span-3 = a platinum ph: icon (ph:infinity / ph:terminal-window / ph:squares-four / ph:books, 19px) + an H3 (text-[16.5px] font-medium off); col-span-8 = a max-w-[60ch] font-light plat2 paragraph. Rows: 01 Infinite canvas, 02 Agent-native, 03 Real components, 04 Prompt library, each with the matching copy.

### Testimonial + stats panel
Section id=customers, py-8 pb-28. A grid lg:grid-cols-2 gap-px on a bg-line2 base, rounded-2xl border-line2 overflow-hidden (so the 1px gap reads as a hairline divider). Left cell (bg-ink2 p-10/12): a large line-colored ph:quotes-fill, a text-[clamp(1.15rem,2.2vw,1.5rem)] font-light off pull-quote ('We went from a Figma backlog to shipping screens the same afternoon. Slate is the first design tool our engineers actually open.'), and an attribution row (a 9x9 from-plat to-plat2 gradient avatar circle + 'Dana Ortiz' off / 'Head of Product, Corewave' mute2). Right cell (bg-ink2 p-10/12, flex-col justify-between): a 3-up stats row (10x faster first draft / 57k designers building / 4.9 avg. rating) with each number in .plat-text font-semibold text-[clamp(1.8rem,3vw,2.4rem)]; below, a rounded-xl border-line bg-ink3 faux-terminal card with a '~/project' header (plat ph:terminal) and a 2-line mono snippet: '$ superdesign create "settings page, dark, calm"' then '-> 3 variants on the canvas check', with the prompt text in off and the check in plat.

### Pricing (minimal, 3-tier)
Section id=pricing, py-8 pb-32. A centered max-w-[34ch] header: eyebrow 'Pricing' + H2 .plat-text 'Simple, while you scale'. Then a grid md:grid-cols-3 gap-5 max-w-[980px] mx-auto of three plans. Starter ($0/mo) and Team ($60/mo) are plain rounded-2xl border-line2 bg-ink2 p-7 cards with a ghost CTA (rounded-full border-line plat2 that gains a plat border + off text on hover) and a check-list (plat ph:check + plat2 items). The middle Pro ($20/mo) plan is featured: rounded-2xl border-plat/40 .card-sheen p-7 .ring-soft with an absolute -top-2.5 'Most popular' .btn-plat pill (dark ink) and a solid .btn-plat 'Get Pro' CTA (dark ink). Plan price is text-[2.4rem] font-semibold off with a /mo in mute2; each plan has a one-line descriptor and 3-4 feature checks.

### Closing CTA
A relative overflow-hidden section with a top border-line2 and an absolute inset-0 .grain wash. Centered content mx-auto max-w-[1200px] px-6 -> lg:px-8 py-28: an H2 .plat-text max-w-[18ch] 'Stop describing the UI. Start seeing it.' (text-[clamp(2rem,5vw,3.6rem)] tracking-tightest), a max-w-[44ch] font-light plat2 subline 'Your next interface is one prompt away. Free to start, no card required.', and a CTA row (justify-center, gap-3): a solid .btn-plat 'Get started' pill (dark ink, px-6 py-3) + a ghost 'Book a demo' pill (border-line plat2, hover plat border + off text).

### Footer (dark, 4-column)
A footer with border-t line2 and bg-ink2/40. Inside mx-auto max-w-[1200px] px-6 -> lg:px-8 py-14: a grid md:grid-cols-12 gap-10. First block (md:col-span-4): the brand lockup (platinum gradient sparkle square + 'Slate' off) + a max-w-[32ch] mute2 blurb. Right block (md:col-span-8): a grid grid-cols-2 -> sm:grid-cols-4 gap-8 of four link columns (Product / Company / Resources / Legal), each an uppercase mute2 heading + a space-y list of plat2 links that hover:text-off. Below: a .hairline h-px my-10 divider, then a flex-col -> sm:flex-row space-between row (text-[12.5px] mute2): a copyright line and three social icon links (ph:x-logo, ph:github-logo, ph:linkedin-logo) that hover to plat2.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Platinum gradient-clipped display headline (.plat-text) — The recurring brand flourish: every large heading is filled with a white-to-platinum top-to-bottom gradient clipped to the glyphs, so the type itself carries the only 'shine' on an otherwise grey page.
Define .plat-text { background: linear-gradient(180deg,#ffffff 0%,#c7c7cc 100%); -webkit-background-clip:text; background-clip:text; color:transparent }. Apply it to the hero H1, every section H2, and the CTA H2 (always with tracking-tightest font-semibold). Used as the single source of brightness instead of a colored accent.

### Platinum pill button (.btn-plat) — The one filled control on the page: a fully rounded pill with a brushed-platinum gradient and dark ink text, used for the nav 'Get started', the featured pricing CTA, the 'Most popular' badge, and the closing CTA.
Build with .btn-plat { background: linear-gradient(180deg,#ededf0,#c7c7cc) } + text-ink (the #1c1c1e page color) + font-medium/semibold + rounded-full + hover:brightness-105. Ghost/secondary variant = transparent with a border-line border and plat2 text that gains a plat border + off text on hover. Never color it; the platinum-on-dark-ink contrast is the whole point.

### In-page product canvas mock (frameless) — A large embedded app-canvas panel that stands in for the hero product shot: an app toolbar, a layers rail, a generated revenue-dashboard card with KPI cells and a bar chart, and a right prompt panel, all on a dot-grid. Not a browser or device frame.
rounded-2xl border-line bg-ink2 .ring-soft overflow-hidden. Top app toolbar (h-11 border-b line2 bg-ink3): file breadcrumb left, view-tool icons + '100%' zoom pill right. Body = 12-col grid min-h-[340px] .dot-grid: left col-span-2 layers rail (hidden lg), center col-span-7 generated UI = a .card-sheen card with a Day/Week toggle (Week active = bg-plat dark-ink), a 3-up KPI row, and a 9-bar chart (mostly bg-line with two bg-plat/bg-plat2 accent bars) + a 'Generated' plat pill, right col-span-3 prompt panel (hidden lg) with a quoted prompt, a spinning ph:circle-notch 'Generating variants...', skeleton bars, and an 'Ask Slate to refine...' input.

### Hairline-only section system — Sections and the feature list are separated by 1px graphite borders and a centered gradient hairline rather than by background color blocks, which is what gives the page its calm, engineered restraint.
Use border-line (#39393c) / border-line2 (#2e2e30) hairlines: border-y on the logo strip, divide-y divide-line2 with a bounding border-y on the feature list (no card backgrounds), gap-px on a bg-line2 base to fake a 1px divider between the testimonial and stats cells, and a .hairline element (linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(199,199,204,0.18) 22%/78%, transparent), h-px) as the footer divider. Atmosphere comes from .grain radial glows and a 22px .dot-grid, not from colored panels.

## Notas Especiais
Frameless, fully responsive premium SaaS marketing landing page (no browser chrome / no device frame): every section centers in mx-auto max-w-[1200px] with px-6 -> lg:px-8; the hero product mock is a 12-col grid whose left layers rail (col-span-2) and right prompt panel (col-span-3) hide below lg; the feature list is a md:grid-cols-12 hairline-divided list; the testimonial/stats panel is lg:grid-cols-2; pricing is md:grid-cols-3 -> 1; the footer is md:grid-cols-12 with link columns 2-up on mobile; the nav links hide below md; everything collapses to one column on mobile; the nav is fixed + glassy (backdrop-blur). Built with Tailwind via CDN plus a small tailwind.config registering the custom graphite/platinum colors (ink #1c1c1e, ink2 #202022, ink3 #252527, panel #2c2c2e, line #39393c, line2 #2e2e30, plat #c7c7cc, plat2 #aeaeb2, off #f2f2f4, mute #8e8e93, mute2 #6c6c70), the Inter font family, and the tightest letter-spacing; Google Fonts loads Inter 300-700; icons are Iconify Phosphor (ph:) glyphs. All copy and the 'Slate' brand are placeholders meant to be swapped: the transferable value is the graphite near-monochrome palette with a SINGLE platinum accent (#c7c7cc, as the .plat-text white->platinum clipped headline gradient and the .btn-plat brushed-platinum pill, on #1c1c1e->#2c2c2e surfaces with #f2f2f4 text and hairline borders) and the restrained Linear-like full-funnel SaaS layout (sticky glass nav -> left-aligned hero with an in-page product-canvas mock -> quiet logo row -> thin numbered feature list -> testimonial+stats split -> minimal 3-tier pricing -> grain CTA -> 4-column footer), NOT the specific product. Strictly no indigo/violet/blue: the only accent is platinum.

style.description: Premium, calm, near-monochrome dark mode built almost entirely from graphite greys with a single platinum/silver accent. The page is a stack of charcoal surfaces (page #1c1c1e, panels #202022/#252527/#2c2c2e) separated by 1px hairline borders (#39393c, #2e2e30) rather than color. Text is off-white #f2f2f4 for primary, platinum #c7c7cc / #aeaeb2 for secondary and links, and muted greys #8e8e93 / #6c6c70 reserved only for eyebrows and micro-labels. The lone accent is platinum #c7c7cc: it fills the primary pill button (as a #ededf0 to #c7c7cc gradient with dark ink text), tints feature icons and check marks, and is clipped onto every big display heading as a #ffffff to #c7c7cc top-to-bottom gradient ('plat-text'). Depth comes from craft, not color: a soft platinum-ring drop shadow on framed panels (ring-soft), faint radial 'grain' glows behind the hero/CTA, a 22px dot-grid on the canvas mock, a centered hairline gradient divider, and a subtle card sheen on featured surfaces. Tight Inter (weights 300-700) with negative letter-spacing on display type gives the whole thing a restrained, engineered, Linear-like feel.

layout_and_structure.description: A single-column, vertically stacked, frameless responsive marketing page. Almost every section centers inside mx-auto max-w-[1200px] with px-6 -> lg:px-8 padding. Order top to bottom: sticky glass nav; hero (left-aligned badge + display headline + a row that splits the lead paragraph from a small 'New' link, then a large full-width product-canvas mock); a quiet bordered logo row; a thin numbered feature list (4 rows on a 12-col grid, divided by hairlines, no cards); a two-up panel (a pull-quote testimonial beside a stats + faux-terminal cell); a minimal 3-column pricing block (middle plan featured with a platinum ring); a centered closing CTA over a grain wash; and a dark 4-column footer with a hairline divider and a bottom legal/social row. Reflow: the hero canvas mock is a 12-col grid (left layers rail col-span-2 and right prompt panel col-span-3 are hidden below lg, leaving the generated UI full width); feature rows go md:grid-cols-12 -> stacked; the testimonial/stats panel is lg:grid-cols-2; pricing is md:grid-cols-3 -> 1; the footer is md:grid-cols-12 with link columns 2-up on mobile. Everything collapses to one column on mobile; the nav links hide below md.

Right prompt panel (hidden lg:flex col-span-3, border-l line2, bg-ink2/80, p-4): a 'PROMPT' eyebrow, a quoted example prompt in a rounded-lg border-line bg-ink3 box, a 'Generating variants...' line with a spinning ph:circle-notch (plat), two skeleton bars, and a bottom 'Ask Slate to refine...' input row with a ph:sparkle.

A quiet trust strip: a section with border-y line2 and bg-ink2/40. Inside mx-auto max-w-[1200px] px-6 -> lg:px-8 py-10: a centered uppercase eyebrow 'Trusted by teams building at speed' (text-[12px] tracking-[0.18em] mute2), then a flex-wrap justify-center row (gap-x-12 gap-y-6, opacity-70) of six faux company lockups, each a ph: geometric glyph (hexagon/triangle/circle-half/square/diamond/asterisk) + an extrabold-ish plat2 wordmark: Northwind, Vantage, Corewave, Monoco, Lattice, Forma.

Section id=features, py-28. A max-w-[40ch] header: eyebrow 'Built for the work', then an H2 .plat-text 'Everything between idea and shippable UI'. Below, a divide-y divide-line2 list bounded by border-y line2 (NO cards). Each row is a grid md:grid-cols-12 gap-5 py-8: col-span-1 = a tabular-nums mute2 index (01-04); col-span-3 = a platinum ph: icon (ph:infinity / ph:terminal-window / ph:squares-four / ph:books, 19px) + an H3 (text-[16.5px] font-medium off); col-span-8 = a max-w-[60ch] font-light plat2 paragraph. Rows: 01 Infinite canvas, 02 Agent-native, 03 Real components, 04 Prompt library, each with the matching copy.

Section id=customers, py-8 pb-28. A grid lg:grid-cols-2 gap-px on a bg-line2 base, rounded-2xl border-line2 overflow-hidden (so the 1px gap reads as a hairline divider). Left cell (bg-ink2 p-10/12): a large line-colored ph:quotes-fill, a text-[clamp(1.15rem,2.2vw,1.5rem)] font-light off pull-quote ('We went from a Figma backlog to shipping screens the same afternoon. Slate is the first design tool our engineers actually open.'), and an attribution row (a 9x9 from-plat to-plat2 gradient avatar circle + 'Dana Ortiz' off / 'Head of Product, Corewave' mute2). Right cell (bg-ink2 p-10/12, flex-col justify-between): a 3-up stats row (10x faster first draft / 57k designers building / 4.9 avg. rating) with each number in .plat-text font-semibold text-[clamp(1.8rem,3vw,2.4rem)]; below, a rounded-xl border-line bg-ink3 faux-terminal card with a '~/project' header (plat ph:terminal) and a 2-line mono snippet: '$ superdesign create "settings page, dark, calm"' then '-> 3 variants on the canvas check', with the prompt text in off and the check in plat.

Section id=pricing, py-8 pb-32. A centered max-w-[34ch] header: eyebrow 'Pricing' + H2 .plat-text 'Simple, while you scale'. Then a grid md:grid-cols-3 gap-5 max-w-[980px] mx-auto of three plans. Starter ($0/mo) and Team ($60/mo) are plain rounded-2xl border-line2 bg-ink2 p-7 cards with a ghost CTA (rounded-full border-line plat2 that gains a plat border + off text on hover) and a check-list (plat ph:check + plat2 items). The middle Pro ($20/mo) plan is featured: rounded-2xl border-plat/40 .card-sheen p-7 .ring-soft with an absolute -top-2.5 'Most popular' .btn-plat pill (dark ink) and a solid .btn-plat 'Get Pro' CTA (dark ink). Plan price is text-[2.4rem] font-semibold off with a /mo in mute2; each plan has a one-line descriptor and 3-4 feature checks.

A relative overflow-hidden section with a top border-line2 and an absolute inset-0 .grain wash. Centered content mx-auto max-w-[1200px] px-6 -> lg:px-8 py-28: an H2 .plat-text max-w-[18ch] 'Stop describing the UI. Start seeing it.' (text-[clamp(2rem,5vw,3.6rem)] tracking-tightest), a max-w-[44ch] font-light plat2 subline 'Your next interface is one prompt away. Free to start, no card required.', and a CTA row (justify-center, gap-3): a solid .btn-plat 'Get started' pill (dark ink, px-6 py-3) + a ghost 'Book a demo' pill (border-line plat2, hover plat border + off text).

A footer with border-t line2 and bg-ink2/40. Inside mx-auto max-w-[1200px] px-6 -> lg:px-8 py-14: a grid md:grid-cols-12 gap-10. First block (md:col-span-4): the brand lockup (platinum gradient sparkle square + 'Slate' off) + a max-w-[32ch] mute2 blurb. Right block (md:col-span-8): a grid grid-cols-2 -> sm:grid-cols-4 gap-8 of four link columns (Product / Company / Resources / Legal), each an uppercase mute2 heading + a space-y list of plat2 links that hover:text-off. Below: a .hairline h-px my-10 divider, then a flex-col -> sm:flex-row space-between row (text-[12.5px] mute2): a copyright line and three social icon links (ph:x-logo, ph:github-logo, ph:linkedin-logo) that hover to plat2.

special_ui_components.description: The recurring brand flourish: every large heading is filled with a white-to-platinum top-to-bottom gradient clipped to the glyphs, so the type itself carries the only 'shine' on an otherwise grey page.
special_ui_components.prompt: Define .plat-text { background: linear-gradient(180deg,#ffffff 0%,#c7c7cc 100%); -webkit-background-clip:text; background-clip:text; color:transparent }. Apply it to the hero H1, every section H2, and the CTA H2 (always with tracking-tightest font-semibold). Used as the single source of brightness instead of a colored accent.

special_ui_components.description: The one filled control on the page: a fully rounded pill with a brushed-platinum gradient and dark ink text, used for the nav 'Get started', the featured pricing CTA, the 'Most popular' badge, and the closing CTA.
special_ui_components.prompt: Build with .btn-plat { background: linear-gradient(180deg,#ededf0,#c7c7cc) } + text-ink (the #1c1c1e page color) + font-medium/semibold + rounded-full + hover:brightness-105. Ghost/secondary variant = transparent with a border-line border and plat2 text that gains a plat border + off text on hover. Never color it; the platinum-on-dark-ink contrast is the whole point.

special_ui_components.description: A large embedded app-canvas panel that stands in for the hero product shot: an app toolbar, a layers rail, a generated revenue-dashboard card with KPI cells and a bar chart, and a right prompt panel, all on a dot-grid. Not a browser or device frame.
special_ui_components.prompt: rounded-2xl border-line bg-ink2 .ring-soft overflow-hidden. Top app toolbar (h-11 border-b line2 bg-ink3): file breadcrumb left, view-tool icons + '100%' zoom pill right. Body = 12-col grid min-h-[340px] .dot-grid: left col-span-2 layers rail (hidden lg), center col-span-7 generated UI = a .card-sheen card with a Day/Week toggle (Week active = bg-plat dark-ink), a 3-up KPI row, and a 9-bar chart (mostly bg-line with two bg-plat/bg-plat2 accent bars) + a 'Generated' plat pill, right col-span-3 prompt panel (hidden lg) with a quoted prompt, a spinning ph:circle-notch 'Generating variants...', skeleton bars, and an 'Ask Slate to refine...' input.

special_ui_components.description: Sections and the feature list are separated by 1px graphite borders and a centered gradient hairline rather than by background color blocks, which is what gives the page its calm, engineered restraint.
special_ui_components.prompt: Use border-line (#39393c) / border-line2 (#2e2e30) hairlines: border-y on the logo strip, divide-y divide-line2 with a bounding border-y on the feature list (no card backgrounds), gap-px on a bg-line2 base to fake a 1px divider between the testimonial and stats cells, and a .hairline element (linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(199,199,204,0.18) 22%/78%, transparent), h-px) as the footer divider. Atmosphere comes from .grain radial glows and a 22px .dot-grid, not from colored panels.

structured.special_notes: Frameless, fully responsive premium SaaS marketing landing page (no browser chrome / no device frame): every section centers in mx-auto max-w-[1200px] with px-6 -> lg:px-8; the hero product mock is a 12-col grid whose left layers rail (col-span-2) and right prompt panel (col-span-3) hide below lg; the feature list is a md:grid-cols-12 hairline-divided list; the testimonial/stats panel is lg:grid-cols-2; pricing is md:grid-cols-3 -> 1; the footer is md:grid-cols-12 with link columns 2-up on mobile; the nav links hide below md; everything collapses to one column on mobile; the nav is fixed + glassy (backdrop-blur). Built with Tailwind via CDN plus a small tailwind.config registering the custom graphite/platinum colors (ink #1c1c1e, ink2 #202022, ink3 #252527, panel #2c2c2e, line #39393c, line2 #2e2e30, plat #c7c7cc, plat2 #aeaeb2, off #f2f2f4, mute #8e8e93, mute2 #6c6c70), the Inter font family, and the tightest letter-spacing; Google Fonts loads Inter 300-700; icons are Iconify Phosphor (ph:) glyphs. All copy and the 'Slate' brand are placeholders meant to be swapped: the transferable value is the graphite near-monochrome palette with a SINGLE platinum accent (#c7c7cc, as the .plat-text white->platinum clipped headline gradient and the .btn-plat brushed-platinum pill, on #1c1c1e->#2c2c2e surfaces with #f2f2f4 text and hairline borders) and the restrained Linear-like full-funnel SaaS layout (sticky glass nav -> left-aligned hero with an in-page product-canvas mock -> quiet logo row -> thin numbered feature list -> testimonial+stats split -> minimal 3-tier pricing -> grain CTA -> 4-column footer), NOT the specific product. Strictly no indigo/violet/blue: the only accent is platinum.
